description: Implement What-If Savings Simulator: allow users to simulate turning an appliance off or changing operating hours WITHOUT saving changes. Display comparison: original vs proposed energy consumption (daily and monthly), original vs proposed cost, potential savings. Include Apply and Cancel buttons. Depends on FEAT-002 calculations, FEAT-003 appliances, FEAT-006 appliance list.
steps: Add to bottom nav or accessible from Dashboard/Appliances (as a new tab or dialog)
Implement UI: dropdown to select an appliance from current list, radio/toggle buttons: 'Turn Off' or 'Change Hours', conditional TextField for new hours
On change, calculate proposed scenario using CalculationService WITHOUT modifying original appliance
Display comparison in 2-column or card layout: 'Original vs Proposed'
Show: daily kWh (original, proposed, diff), daily PHP cost (original, proposed, diff), monthly kWh (original, proposed, diff), monthly PHP (original, proposed, diff), percentage savings
Apply: updates appliance via ApplianceService if user confirms, triggers app-wide update
Cancel: discards simulation, returns to previous screen without changes
Add confirmation dialog before applying: 'This will update the appliance settings. Continue?'
acceptance_criteria: User can select an appliance from dropdown
User can choose 'Turn Off' or 'Change Hours'
When 'Change Hours' selected, hours field appears and accepts input
Proposed scenario calculated correctly without modifying original
Comparison displayed: original, proposed, savings for both kWh and PHP
Savings shown in green, clearly visible
Apply button saves changes and updates app state
After applying, screen shows confirmation and updates persist
verification: Run: flutter analyze lib/screens/whatif_simulator_screen.dart — no errors

Run: flutter run and manually verify: open simulator, select a fan (70W), choose 'Change Hours' to 2 hours, see original vs proposed consumption and cost calculated correctly, verify savings shown, click Apply, confirm dialog, appliance hours updated and persisted, verify Dashboard now shows new consumption; repeat test with 'Turn Off' option
